notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Launched!
notes.content:
[h3]After more than two years of development and polish, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dh_25_05_27]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] is now fully released![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/31bc05a8c948a911314958b915c492390642fce3.png[/img]

[h3]Out of Early Access.[/h3]
The visual novel is complete with all its planned features and fully playable from the start to the bitter end! ːedgardoː With multiple endings.

[h3]Partial voice acting added[/h3]
All seven chapters now include some voice lines to better establish the characters.

[h3]Mac version now available[/h3]
The game now supports both Windows and macOS.

[h3]Artbook DLC released[/h3]
Take a behind-the-scenes look at sketches, concepts and early drafts in a beautifully compiled PDF! Grab the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699290/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial__Artbook/]artbook[/url] and support future creative projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/abb2b1e1af95620866f824f4813859f17f9f3fb5.jpg[/img]

I've poured a lot into this visual novel over the past years - writing, editing, coordinating, testing... It was the story I really wanted to tell, and I hope you'll enjoy the finished version.

[h3]Now is the perfect time to jump in - or back in![/h3]

If you've enjoyed it, a short review or share on social media really helps spread the word!

Thank you for supporting indie games and making releases like this possible!💜

- Lamb

tags.feature: Partial voice acting added
Mac version now available
Artbook DLC released

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Final chapter released!
notes.content:
[h2]The final chapter of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_25_03_29]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] is live![/h2]

The total word count is now over 160.000 words, making it my longest VN so far. ːdazed_yetiː

Plans for the future involve implementing partial voice acting and making a Mac OS version of the Cursed Trial, as well as planning a new potential game in this universe. ːhappy_yetiː

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Chapter 6 Released!
notes.content:
[h3]My latest project in the Demonheart world just got a major update![/h3]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_24_09_24]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] Chapter 6 is out![/h2]

With around 21.900 words of new content, this takes the game over 133.000 words - my longest game so far. 

The story continues, with only one more chapter left to go (which will have multiple endings.)

I hope you'll enjoy the new addition! 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/9839c1bd8183b6c3b1bd295c68fb720df5b72fe6.jpg[/img]

The Cursed Trial is a murder mystery / romance in which Raze ("The Seer") has captured a group of humans for the entertainment of his demonic master. (Raze doesn't really have a master, he just made a deal with someone and is playing along.)

The main character, whose name you can change, can fall in love with two of her fellow captives.

[b]If you haven't joined in on the adventure yet, consider doing so now by wishlisting or purchasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_24_09_24]The Cursed Trial[/url] - your interest and support help me develop these niche games![/b]

notes.title: Cursed Trial - Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/b7238acd9f3138009f0174eb5580a6a91ba2728b.jpg[/img]

While working on the third out of the seven chapters of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23-10-20]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url], I went back to the first chapter (demo) and made some edits. There are a lot of small changes which you may or may not notice if you replay.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Rephrased many lines of narration and dialog.
[*] Changed some expressions and sprite positions. Changed Ran's expression on several occasions into less childish and more manly ones. ':)
[*] Added a few new choices and NPC lines - nothing crucial, but these changes will mess with old saves. Old alignment and relationship points will be preserved, but you may end up on the wrong line when you reload.
[*] Started silently tracking Janiya's approval. Old saves didn't track this, so it will be like your relationship with her was neutral. Which is not the worst it could be. ':)
[*] Changed some sound effects.
[/list]

[h1]The demo is available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23-10-20]here[/url]! Don't forget to wishlist the Cursed Trial![/h1]

Meanwhile, the third chapter is nearly finished, and when it's polished, there's a possibility of Steam early access! Stay tuned for news about it, and thank you for following!

notes.title: Update + Cursed Trial Demo
notes.content:
The updates brought by version 2.00+ are now included in the latest Mac OS build. Also, the Mac build is now signed and notarized by Apple.

We also fixed a few issues on all operating systems:
[list]
[*] Achievement Touchy Fingers should work again (when you click on the demonspawn's amulet in the main menu you should hear his voice.)
[*] The mouse cursor should no longer change to the default arrow at the edges of the screen.
[/list]
The updates introduced in v2.00, now included in the Mac OS build, were:
[list]
[*] The conversation UI can now be hidden by middle-clicking with the mouse, and restored on any click.
[*] Right-clicking closes menus, as is common in some visual novels.
[*] Added an in-game screen with achievements progress.
[*] Exploration mode now shows where the explorable objects are. (Also, its whole implementation had to change due to the engine change.)
[*] Clarified the anagram minigame message in English - that you need to drag the letters.
[*] Steam Overlay and screenshots should work without having to enable anything.
[*] Slightly restyled some parts of the UI. Increased font size.
[/list]
If the new version doesn't work for you for any reason, you can use Steam's Betas functionality to revert to version 1.65 (the branch name is v165.)

[h2]In other news, the demo for Demonheart: The Cursed Trial is coming to Steam soon![/h2]
It's scheduled to come out on June 20th.

Check out the game and add it to your wishlist if you haven't done so already:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dh3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/343041a500bcd58e525763a41c86f7010cce1ea4.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Jester / King Demo Update v1.06 - Voice Acting
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce an updated version of the Jester / King demo, now with voice acting!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33404344/34ea3e9fab9de90204481b1b16b8f67fdd71d2bb.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, I've started commissioning art for a new VN in the Demonheart world and opened a [url=https://www.patreon.com/rollingcrown]Patreon[/url] where you can check how it's going. If you like what I'm making, please consider supporting me.

notes.title: Demonheart in German!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27939525/2500172a05a1007ae803c90d9335d28e4f4e3f59.jpg[/img]

[h1]Demonheart is now available in German.[/h1]
Many thanks to Cesear for the translation, and to Sylveranty and Xaladin for proofreading!

How to set the language:[list]
[*] If your language on Steam is set to German and you don't have Demonheart installed, the game will get installed in German.
[*] If the game is already installed in English, you'll need to uninstall the game, set your Steam client language to German, restart the Steam client and install Demonheart again.
[/list]
Also, the Russian translation is almost done! If more people want to help with translating into other languages, you're welcome to!

[h1]Demonheart ist jetzt auch auf Deutsch verfügbar.[/h1]
Vielen Dank an Cesear für die Übersetzung, und an Sylveranty und Xaladin für das Korrekturlesen!

Um die Sprache einzustellen:[list]
[*] Wenn die Sprache bei deinem Steam Client auf Deutsch gestellt ist, und du Demonheart noch nicht installiert hattest, wird das Spiel automatisch auf Deutsch installiert.
[*] Wenn du das Spiel schon in englischer Sprache installiert hast, musst du das Spiel deinstallieren, die Einstellung der Sprache deines Steam Clients auf Deutsch stellen, den Steam Client neustarten, und Demonheart erneut installieren.
[/list]
Außerdem ist die russische Übersetzung fast fertig gestellt! Falls mehr Leute dabei helfen wollen, Demonheart in andere Sprachen zu übersetzen, seid ihr herzlich dazu eingeladen!

notes.title: Chapter 4 Released
notes.content:
[b]This Christmas, a demonspawn arrives from Inferno to entertain you! Ouch.
Demonheart has been updated and now includes the fourth chapter.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27939525/9847f56cbe9da3af9eab51ffa365e6c8047e01a8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Update Notes (v1.41)[/h1]

[b]Content:[/b]
[list][*]Chapter 4 added to the game.
[*]Added six new achievements that can be unlocked in Chapter 4.
[*]Added a disturbed expression to Tunes model.
[*]Replaced one forest background in C2 with a more detailed version.
[*]Improved some Brash lines in C3 if Bright did not try to run away so they make more sense in the current situation.
[/list]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*]The character/alignment screen now displays your current character points as a percentage when you mouse over the white heart. (The game starts at 50% Tactful, 50% Good.)
[*]Added a message in the upper corner when an anagram starts for clarification - "Decipher the message!"
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a couple of misused words/typos in C1 and C3.
[*]Improved the way Jasper is displayed, so that his sword is in front of the other characters.
[*]Added one more fix for displaying animated characters.
[*]Fixed a bug that could happen when starting the game and immediately clicking on another window, where you'd get Raze's floating head instead of his whole model. 😃
[*]Added a fix for the game window flashing white on game start.
[*]Fixed the visual effect when entering Orchid's library.
[*]Fixed some grey button flickering that could sometimes happen when selecting chapters.
[/list]
[h1]Merry Christmas to all those who celebrate it![/h1]

notes.title: Update v1.35 - Skip Option
notes.content:
[*]A skip option will appear in the lower right corner of the conversation space. You can also activate it by pressing the arrow right key. Skip will fast forward through parts of the game you've already seen, until the next choice or new content.

[*]From now on when you play, the game will remember which parts you've already seen. It will also attempt to register content from your saves. Depending on how often you saved, you might have to replay some parts before they become skippable.

Initially I thought the skip function wouldn't do much because choices are everywhere, but it does help to save some time, and there [i]are[/i] some sequences of 10+ lines without choices. :)

notes.title: Chapter 2 Is Out
notes.content:
Chapter 2 has been included in the game build! Just let the game update itself and you will have access to it.

Continue the journey and you will soon be contacted by your Infernal patron. The good times are about to begin.

[h1]Starting Chapter 2[/h1]
- If you are playing Chapter 1, the game will continue automatically.
- If you want to start Chapter 2 separately, you will need at least one autosave from the end of Chapter 1.
- When you go to "New Chapter -> 2: Reverie", the chapter will start from your latest autosave from the end of Chapter 1. If you want to use a different save, you should go to "Load" instead.

[h1]Steam Overlay[/h1]
If you want to access the Steam community in-game and be able to take screenshots, you should go to "Settings" and check the "Steam Overlay" checkbox. (We disabled it by default because a certain setting in the engine we are using both enables the overlay and causes performance issues on some system specs.)
